articles.title: IMD Warns of Thunderstorms and Lightning Until October 20 For Telangana - Telangana Tribune
articles.full_text:
According to the IMD’s subdivision-wise warning bulletin issued on October 16, thunderstorm and lightning warnings are in place from October 16 to October 20, 2026. The bulletin lists no subdivision-level warning for October 21 and 22. The official IMD warning bulletin provides the latest information.
Will It Rain in Hyderabad?
Hyderabad residents may experience changing weather conditions, including the possibility of rain and thundershowers. However, the statewide warning does not mean that every part of the city will receive heavy rainfall.
Residents should check the latest Hyderabad city forecast and district-level warnings before making travel or outdoor plans. The intensity and timing of rainfall can vary across different parts of Telangana.
The IMD’s Hyderabad Meteorological Centre website provides city forecasts, district-wise warnings and weather updates.
Northeast Monsoon Brings Changing Weather Conditions
The weather warning comes amid the seasonal transition towards the northeast monsoon over southern peninsular India. The IMD has reported the early onset of the northeast monsoon, which is an important source of rainfall for several southern states.
Rainfall activity during this period can be influenced by atmospheric circulations and weather systems over the Bay of Bengal and adjoining regions. These systems may bring showers, thunderstorms and lightning to parts of Telangana, depending on their movement and intensity.
Safety Precautions for Residents
Residents are advised to take precautions during thunderstorms and lightning, particularly when travelling or working outdoors.
- Avoid standing in open areas or beneath isolated trees during lightning activity.
- Stay away from electric poles, exposed wiring, and other metal structures during thunderstorms.
- Motorists should drive cautiously during rain and watch for slippery roads and reduced visibility.
- People living in low-lying areas should remain alert to local advisories if heavy rain occurs.
- Check official weather updates before travelling, especially during periods of active thunderstorms.
Where to Check the Latest Telangana Weather Updates
For the latest forecast, residents can visit the following official resources:
- IMD Meteorological Centre, Hyderabad – city forecasts and weather information.
- IMD Weather Warnings – subdivision-wise and district-wise warnings.
Important: The current subdivision-level warning identifies thunderstorms and lightning through October 20. It should not be interpreted as a statewide heavy-rain warning for every day. Residents should refer to the latest district-wise bulletin for specific rainfall alerts.
